title: We are doing AI Game Jam with 5k USD prizepool
author: Gamerrecruiter
selftext:
Hi, I am one of the team members of Loadout. Been lurking here for a while and there are so many awesome games being posted here so when we decided to host our own AI Game Jam, I thought to give you all opportunity to join. Whether you have already existing game or you want to put something fresh together, all are welcome. As long as you are using AI to build it :) 

You can find out more via our X [https://x.com/loadoutprotocol/status/2116185614013886842](https://x.com/loadoutprotocol/status/2116185614013886842) 

Looking forward to see your games and good luck to all!
